name: Dread Knight
description: (Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Dread Knight, a higher Undead caste specializing in direct martial combat. You gain very potent physical abilities and virtually unlimited stamina, needing only Energy to sustain yourself. You can naturally use [Dread Blade] and gain great Necromancy, Darkness, and Martial affinity, augmenting related abilities, skills, and magic, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
